title: Game Producer (Hybrid Casual)
description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Belka Games
Belka Games is a game development company. According to Sensor Tower, the company is among the top 30 highest-grossing game developers in Europe, and its audience has recently surpassed 110 million players.
Role Overview
We’re looking for an experienced Game Producer to build new Hybrid Casual games from scratch .
You’ll identify product opportunities, test game hypotheses, and guide projects from concept and prototype through marketability, launch, retention validation, and D7/D30 performance evaluation.
This role is ideal for someone with hands-on Hybrid Casual experience who can move quickly in a high-uncertainty environment, make data-driven decisions, and confidently decide when to iterate - and when to stop.
Key Responsibilities

•
Creating new games from scratch. Identify promising product opportunities and turn them into testable game concepts and prototypes

•
Researching the market. Monitor Hybrid Casual trends, emerging mechanics, successful products, competitors, player behavior, and new market opportunities

•
Leading projects through early-stage validation. Take games from concept and prototype through marketability testing, technical launch, retention testing, and D7/D30 validation

•
Defining product hypotheses and validation criteria. Determine what needs to be tested at each stage and what minimum product scope is required to get a reliable answer

•
Making go / iterate / kill decisions. Analyze test results and decide whether to continue development, change direction, or stop a project

•
Owning early-stage product metrics. Analyze CPI, CTR, retention, engagement, playtime, monetization, ARPU/ARPDAU, ROAS, and other key indicators of product potential

•
Developing the core product. Work closely with Game Design on core gameplay, progression, difficulty, economy, meta systems, and monetization required for successful validation

•
Working closely with UA and Creative teams. Evaluate marketability and creative potential together with product metrics and identify opportunities for further testing

•
Running multiple product hypotheses. Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of concepts and experiments rather than focusing exclusively on the long-term development of one mature product

•
Leading a cross-functional R&D team. Coordinate Game Design, Development, Art, Analytics, UA, and Creative teams to move from hypothesis to validated product as efficiently as possible

Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• 3+ years of experience as a Game Producer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or Lead Game Designer in mobile games

• Proven experience taking multiple game concepts from idea or prototype to market validation , including projects that reached retention and D7/D30 testing stages.

•
A portfolio of Hybrid Casual projects where you can clearly explain:

• the original product hypothesis

• how the concept was validated

• which metrics were used

• what results were achieved

• what decisions were made based on those results

• Strong understanding of the Hybrid Casual mobile games market , including current genres, mechanics, monetization models, and product trends

• Strong understanding of early-stage product and UA metrics, including C

title: Analista de Sucesso do Cliente PL (Enablement)
description:
A Omie tem como propósito trazer prosperidade para o ecossistema empreendedor brasileiro. Por isso, buscamos por pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento, valorizando perfis que tenham capacidade de adaptação, senso colaborativo e sejam motivadas pela inovação e pelo aprendizado contínuo.
Como Enablement você precisará garantir a capacitação contínua, a padronização de processos e a produtividade do time de Customer. Será o responsável por transformar dores operacionais e gaps de conhecimento em programas de aprendizagem, criando e mantendo atualizados os playbooks, documentações técnicas e rotinas de onboarding (ramp-up) para novos integrantes. Atuará como a ponte entre os diagnósticos operacionais de toda a área de Customer e o desenvolvimento comportamental, de processos e de ferramentas de todas as squads.

Nesta posição, você não será responsável pela elaboração ou condução de treinamentos técnicos e funcionais sobre as regras de negócio e funcionalidades do sistema ERP/Software.
Faça parte da história de uma das empresas de tecnologia que mais cresce no país! 🚀

#Vempra Omie

•
Onboarding e Ramp-up do Time de Customer: Estruturar, gerenciar e evoluir o programa de integração de novos colaboradores de Implementação, Retenção, Engajamento e Suporte, garantindo a redução do tempo necessário para que atinjam a performance ideal.

•
Parceria Estratégica com T&D: Trabalhar em conjunto e constante sinergia com o time de Treinamento & Desenvolvimento (T&D), alinhando metodologias pedagógicas, integrando as trilhas de capacitação às diretrizes institucionais e aproveitando os recursos e plataformas da empresa.

•
Capacitação em Boas Práticas de CS e Atendimento: Criar ferramentas, guias e metodologias para apoiar e orientar o time no atendimento ao cliente em suas diferentes formas, desde a condução de reuniões e treinamentos até o acompanhamento estratégico de contas, garantindo um padrão de excelência na operação.

•
Gestão do Conhecimento e Playbooks: Mapear, padronizar e documentar os processos da área, mantendo uma base de conhecimento centralizada, atualizada e de fácil acesso.

•
Diagnóstico de Gaps de Capacitação: Analisar feedbacks e dados oriundos das frentes de Adoção, Risco, Retenção e auditorias de atendimento para identificar dúvidas recorrentes e oportunidades de melhoria no time.

•
Capacitação em Ferramentas Operacionais: Desenhar e aplicar capacitações práticas sobre o ecossistema de ferramentas do time de Customer (CRM, ferramentas de WhatsApp, Intercom, agendas e sistemas internos).

•
Desenvolvimento de Soft Skills: Criar e/ou apoiar workshops e treinamentos focados em competências comportamentais essenciais para a operação (comunicação assertiva, técnicas de escuta ativa, de-escalation/contorno de objeções, gestão de tempo, negociação e consultividade).

•
Criação de Dashboards e Governança de Dados: Construir, alimentar e monitorar painéis de dados operacionais para acompanhar métricas de ramp-up, eficiência do time, adesão às ferramentas e impactos dos programas de capacitação.

• Graduação completa ou em andamento em Administração, Comunicação/RP, Pedagogia, Gestão de RH, Psicologia, Engenharia de Produção, Tecnologia / Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• Perfil altamente didático, facilitador e empático.

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita para condução de workshops e dinâmicas comportamentais.

• Visão de processos e organização rigorosa para gestão de bases de conhecimento e documentações.

• Perfil protagonista e autônomo, com capacidade de identificar necessidades, puxar frentes de trabalho e conduzir iniciativas de forma independente, desde a estruturação até a entrega.

• Experiência prévia em Enablement, Treinamento & Desenvolvimento de Operações, CS Ops ou Capacitação em Atendimento/CS.

• Experiência prévia em empresas B2B SaaS ou startups de tecnologia.

title: Head of Tax
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We're still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you're excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

THE ROLE

In the role of Head of Tax, you will serve as both strategic safeguard and functional architect. Rather than simply overseeing filings, you will architect international tax frameworks that dictate how capital moves across borders, including the US and Latin America. Partnering with Product and Engineering teams, you will embed automated tax calculation and withholding engines into our ecosystem. Managing complex operational scale, you will allow ARQ to expand rapidly while staying fully compliant with evolving tax regulations and transfer pricing rules.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Tax strategy and governance

- Define and own the group’s global tax strategy, aligned with business goals, risk appetite and expansion plans.

- Build and maintain a tax risk management and governance framework, including policies, controls, approval thresholds and documented positions.

- Report regularly on tax matters, exposures and planning opportunities to the CFO, executive team, Board and Audit Committee.

- Monitor legislative and regulatory changes in every jurisdiction where the group operates and assess their impact.

- Corporate income tax and compliance

- Oversee timely, accurate corporate income tax filings and payments for every entity, whether done in-house or through external advisors.

- Manage the global tax compliance calendar and make sure no deadlines are missed in any jurisdiction.

- Oversee estimated and advance tax payments, withholding tax obligations and tax refund claims.

- Maintain an up-to-date entity register with each entity’s tax registrations, residency status and filing obligations.

- International tax and transfer pricing

- Design, document and maintain the group’s transfer pricing policy for intercompany services, IP, financing and cost-sharing arrangements.

- Prepare or oversee Master File, Local Files and Country-by-Country Reporting where required.

- Manage permanent establishment risk, tax residency and substance requirements for each entity.

- Apply double tax treaties, minimize withholding tax leakage and manage foreign tax credits.Review http://credits.Review intercompany agreements, cash repatriation, dividend flows and cross-border financing so they are tax-efficient.

- Indirect taxes

- Oversee VAT/GST and other indirect tax compliance, such as Brazil’s PIS/COFINS/ISS, Argentina’s IIBB and Mexico’s IVA, wherever applicable.

- Define how indirect taxes apply to the group’s products and services, including financial services exemptions, digital services and cross-border supplies.

- Monitor and implement major indirect tax reforms

- Make sure e-invoicing and digital reporting requirements are met in every jurisdiction.

- Financial reporting and accounting

- Own the tax provision process (current and deferred taxes) under IFRS and/or US GAAP and local GAAPs.

- Prepare tax disclosures for consolidated and statutory financial statements.

- Work with Finance and external auditors on tax balances and audit queries.

- Manage the group’s effective tax rate and forecast tax expense and cash taxes for budgeting.

- Regulatory and fintech-specific tax obligations

- Ensure compliance with financial-account information reporting regimes

- Oversee withholding and reporting obligations on customer transactions, interest, FX gains and payments processed for customers.

- Manage transaction taxes and tax obligations that apply to payment and banking activities in each country, such as Argentina’s tax on bank debits and credits.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Supply Chain Sourcing Strategy and Innovation
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
General Description:
The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Chain Sourcing Strategy and Innovation is responsible for advancing strategic sourcing capabilities across Global Clinical Supply Chain within Global R&D Sourcing (GRDS).
This role will lead initiatives focused on sourcing strategy, operating model development, vendor ecosystem optimization, process governance, and innovation to support increasingly complex global clinical trial requirements. The position will work closely with Clinical Operations, Clinical Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Finance, and external partners to develop scalable, compliant, and cost-effective sourcing solutions.
The individual will drive continuous improvement through process standardization, knowledge management, data-driven decision making, and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions, to enhance business efficiency and organizational capability.
This position requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and the ability to influence decision-making across a global matrix organization.
Essential Functions of the Job:

• Lead strategic drug sourcing initiatives supporting global clinical trials.

• Develop and maintain sourcing frameworks, governance models, and decision-making processes.

• Drive comparator sourcing innovation and supplier ecosystem development.

• Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization and operational scalability.

• Establish sourcing intelligence, knowledge management, and best-practice sharing mechanisms.

• Partner with Digital and Technology teams to evaluate and implement AI-enabled solutions and workflow automation.

• Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Finance, and Supply Chain functions.

Hos Transcom bliver du en del af et inkluderende og internationalt arbejdsmiljø, hvor du bliver taget godt imod og får støtte fra første dag. Vi investerer i vores medarbejdere og deres udvikling.

I denne rolle hjælper du kunder med spørgsmål og udfordringer relateret til deres køb - fra bestilling til levering og videre. Du lytter til kunden, forstår deres behov og finder gode og effektive løsninger.

• Finde gode og effektive løsninger, der er tilpasset kundens behov

Hvem leder vi efter?

Vi leder efter dig, der er positiv, løsningsorienteret og oprigtigt interesseret i at hjælpe andre.

Hos Transcom er du aldrig bare en medarbejder - du bliver en del af et globalt fællesskab.

Vi er mere end 33.000 kundeoplevelsesspecialister i 29 lande fordelt på 90 lokationer, og vi leverer tjenester på 33 sprog til internationale brands inden for en lang række forskellige brancher.

Vi fortsætter med at vokse og investerer i vores medarbejdere. Hver dag begynder mennesker deres rejse hos Transcom , hvor de får mulighed for at udvikle deres erfaringer og potentiale til nye kompetencer og karrieremuligheder.

description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SECURITY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- You're securing the frontier of AI. The model weights training on our infrastructure are the most valuable and most targeted artifacts in technology, and we're standing up the compute to hold them faster than anyone ever has. A breach isn't a leak, it's the frontier walking out the door.

- Build the entire security program from scratch. Most leaders inherit someone else's system and spend a career patching it. Here you own it end to end, bare metal to boardroom, as we scale across continents.

- Your threat surface is measured in gigawatts. The customers running on our infrastructure are building the most consequential technology in human history, and being responsible for the physical and logical security of that work makes everything else feel small.

ROLE SCOPE

- Stand up FluidStack's insider risk and counterintelligence program from zero: operating model, roadmap, and the controls that protect some of the most targeted compute infrastructure in the world.

- Design and land technical controls by working through the rest of the security org: detection engineering for monitoring and analytics, IT and infrastructure for identity and data controls, physical security for the badge-to-bare-metal seam.

- Identify process gaps and inefficiencies across the sales funnel and lead improvements, documenting changes and training the team on them.

- Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Product Ops to keep data consistent across systems.

What you’ll bring

- 7+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, GTM operations, or a related commercial role, ideally in a [B2B SaaS / relevant industry] environment.

- Strong experience with CRM systems, ideally Salesforce or HubSpot, including reporting and basic administration.

- Solid understanding of sales metrics and funnel dynamics, including pipeline coverage, conversion, forecasting accuracy, and sales cycle length.

- Proven ability to build clear reports and dashboards in tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI. You don’t need to write code, but you should be comfortable working with data and spotting what matters.

- Experience running pipeline reviews or forecast calls, or supporting leaders who do.

OpenAI's Industrial Compute organization delivers the infrastructure that powers frontier AI models. Within Infrastructure Delivery, we turn engineering concepts into safe, reliable, and operational AI campuses by working across design, construction, utilities, commissioning, operations, and external partners.

The fire protection function establishes the life-safety and property-protection strategy for these campuses. The team connects code requirements and engineering standards to practical design, construction, testing, incident readiness, and long-term operations.

About the Role

We are seeking a Fire Protection Engineer to lead owner-side fire and life-safety engineering across large-scale data center programs. You will establish design criteria, review complex fire protection systems, coordinate with authorities and delivery partners, and ensure that fire and life-safety requirements remain clear from early design through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

This role requires strong technical judgment across detection, alarm, suppression, smoke control, water supply, emergency response, and code compliance. You will work closely with engineering, construction, safety, security, commissioning, and operations teams to resolve risks quickly without compromising life safety, reliability, or schedule.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain fire protection and life-safety design criteria, technical standards, and review requirements for self-build data center campuses.

- Review fire protection drawings, specifications, code analyses, fire and life-safety narratives, hydraulic calculations, equipment submittals, and sequences of operation across all project phases.

- Provide owner-side engineering direction for fire detection and alarm, automatic suppression, fire pumps and water storage, smoke control, emergency communication, and related life-safety systems.

- Integrate fire protection requirements with architectural, structural, electrical, mechanical, controls, security, hardware, and operational systems.

- Partner with code officials, authorities having jurisdiction, insurers, consultants, contractors, and equipment vendors to resolve code interpretations and approval risks.

- Support constructability reviews, RFIs, submittals, field inspections, deficiency resolution, and change management during active construction.

- Define commissioning, integrated-system testing, acceptance, turnover, and operational-readiness criteria for fire and life-safety systems.

- Assess fire and life-safety risks associated with high-density compute, battery and energy-storage systems, generators and fuel systems, utility infrastructure, cooling systems, hazardous materials, and construction activities.

- Support incident response, root-cause reviews, corrective actions, and lessons learned, translating operational findings into improved designs and standards.

- Maintain clear records of design decisions, code positions, approvals, testing results, open risks, and turnover requirements.

- Travel regularly to project sites to support design reviews, field execution, testing, commissioning, and operational readiness.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Fire Protection Engineering or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience delivering fire and life-safety systems.

- 8+ years of fire protection engineering experience supporting data centers, industrial facilities, advanced manufacturing, energy infrastructure, or other mission-critical environments.

- Strong knowledge of applicable building and fire codes and standards, including IBC, IFC, NFPA requirements, and local authority approval processes.

- Technical depth in fire alarm and detection, water-based suppression, special-hazard suppression, fire pumps and water supply, smoke control, egress, and integrated life-safety systems.

- Experience reviewing fire protection designs, specifications, hydraulic calc

title: Investment Banking AI Research Contributor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Aptura is looking for Subject Matter Experts from investment banking or M&A advisory to capture their expertise in Excel. You have used AI tools on your own work and been frustrated by the mistakes they make. You will turn that experience into realistic Excel tasks that test how well AI does the modelling work of an Investment Banking Analyst.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Writing realistic Excel tasks drawn from your own work: extending existing models, fixing broken ones and building from a brief

- Working through each task yourself so there is a clear, correct answer

- Writing yes-or-no criteria precise enough that a grader can mark any attempt against them

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years in investment banking, M&A advisory or corporate development

- Deep hands-on Excel: merger models, pro formas, purchase accounting, precedent transactions, football fields and financial functions

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Attention to detail, and willingness to learn concepts in AI and Evals

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

- Start Date : Immediate

- Duration: Approximately 4-6 weeks

- Payment: task-based. Experts who complete their first task within the required timeline will then be qualified to do multiple tasks for the remainder of the project.

CONTRACT AND PAYMENT TERMS

- You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

- This is a fully remote role that can be completed on your own schedule.

- Projects can be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on needs and performance.

- Your work at Aptura will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information from any employer, client, or institution.

- Payments will be weekly following task completion.

GETTING STARTED

- Apply with your details and CV. Choose an available 30-minute group walkthrough call.

- Attend the walkthrough and create one original task from your own work. Submit the brief, the actual input workbook(s) needed to complete it. Input-file uploads are compulsory.

- Write the brief yourself. Input workbooks must also be human-built. Use real data that has been sanitised, or public data with the source named. No AI usage allowed.

- We run your task against current frontier AI models. If the models get it wrong, you then write a detailed yes-or-no rubric, and a reviewer signs off on the task with you.

- Completing onboarding does not guarantee a job offer; selection remains subject to written approval of the task proposal.

ABOUT APTURA

Aptura is an applied AI and data company working with frontier labs to train AI systems on real professional work. We do this by building high-quality evaluation and training environments that teach AI agents to produce work that can be used in daily workflows.

• Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

• Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

• Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

• Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

• Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

• Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

• Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

• Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

• Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

• A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

• High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

• Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

• Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

• Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

• Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work
We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You own the people and the delivery of your engineers.

title: Head of Solution Consulting R&D / Field CSO
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW

R&D leaders trust people who have done the science. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty.

In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster?

You'll lead our EMEA R&D Solution Consulting organisation: a team of 12, with two first-line leaders covering our Enterprise and Strategic segments, plus occasional support for APAC deals. You'll be the scientific counterpart to our General Manager, EMEA, and work alongside our Field CTO. They lead on IT, data science and architecture; you lead on the scientists and how their work changes.

- Shape EMEA strategy and the roadmap. Decide with sales leadership where to focus the team's expertise, and bring patterns from the field back to Product, Marketing and global Solution Consulting.

HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS

This is a commercial role with a scientific core. We'll look at EMEA revenue growth and influenced pipeline, technical win rate, forecast accuracy on the technical side of deals, regional ownership of our largest R&D relationships, and the strength of your leadership bench.

- A record of driving change, from adopting new technologies to rethinking how your teams work, and clear views on how AI will change R&D.

Our commercial portfolio includes treatments for hypercortisolism and oncology, and the company has discovered more than 1,000 proprietary selective cortisol modulators and glucocorticoid receptor antagonists. With advanced clinical trials in patients with hypercortisolism, solid tumors, ALS and liver disease, Corcept is unlocking the power of cortisol modulation to help address some of the most devastating diseases patients face today. 

Corcept is headquartered in Redwood City, California. To learn more, visit www.corcept.com .

The Associate Director of AWS Cloud Engineering will report to the Director of IT and provide technical leadership for Corcept’s AWS cloud environment, taking the lead on cloud architecture, engineering, and the AWS technology roadmap. This role will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Biometrics, Quality, business teams, and managed service providers to ensure AWS environments are secure, scalable, reliable, and aligned with business needs.

The role will have a strong focus on supporting Biometrics and GxP environments while establishing AWS standards and building cloud engineering expertise within the Infrastructure team. The Associate Director will also provide technical oversight of managed service providers supporting day-to-day AWS operations.

This is a hybrid role, typically requiring on-site presence 4 days per week.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as the technical lead for AWS, providing architecture and engineering direction across cloud initiatives and supporting the development and execution of the AWS roadmap

• Define AWS architecture, engineering standards, and best practices across networking, compute, storage, identity, security, backup, monitoring, and disaster recovery

• Provide technical leadership for AWS environments supporting Biometrics and GxP workloads, partnering with Quality, application owners, and business teams to meet infrastructure, validation, and compliance requirements

• Lead the design and implementation of scalable and resilient AWS solutions supporting new applications, business growth, and infrastructure modernization

• Provide technical oversight and direction to managed service providers supporting AWS operations, ensuring services, changes, and solutions meet Corcept’s technical, security, and operational standards

• Partner with the Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams to strengthen AWS security, access controls, monitoring, vulnerability management, backup, recovery, and operational readiness

• Drive standardization and automation of the AWS environment, including Infrastructure as Code, account and network standards, monitoring, and repeatable deployment practices

• Lead technical reviews and provide guidance for AWS projects, infrastructure changes, migrations, and new cloud services

• Ensure AWS architecture, configurations, operational documentation, and critical technical knowledge are maintained internally and are not solely dependent on external service providers

• Identify opportunities to improve AWS reliability, performance, cost management, operational efficiency, and overall cloud maturity

• Partner with IT and cross-functional teams to understand business and application requirements and translate them into appropriate cloud infrastructure solutions

• Mentor Infrastructure team members and help build AWS technical capabilities and cloud engineering knowledge within the organization

• Communicate AWS strategy, architecture decisions, technical risks, and recommendations to IT leadership and key stakeholders

• Uphold Corcept’s Key Principles by driving collaboration, embracing possibilities, following the data, and leading by doing, ensuring all initiatives align with the Company’s ethics and patient-first principles

You’ll take full ownership of this category, working with suppliers across Europe and with partners in Procurement, Sourcing, Supply Chain, and Distribution Centres across multiple markets.

title: Hematologist
description:
Hematologist
Role type: Contractor
Location: Remote, United States only
Commitment: Part-time, project-based
Compensation: $160-$180 USD per hour
About the role
micro1 is looking for experienced Hematologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.
In this role, you'll use your clinical expertise to evaluate AI-generated transcripts and medical notes from outpatient hematology encounters. Your feedback will help improve the accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance of AI-assisted documentation.
What you'll do

• Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient hematology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.

• Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).

• Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to hematologic diagnoses, treatment plans, medication management, and laboratory findings.

• Assess documentation of blood disorders, including anemia, bleeding and clotting disorders, and hematologic malignancies.

• Review how clinical notes capture treatment responses, adverse effects, transfusion requirements, and follow-up care.

• Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

Required qualifications

• MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Hematology.

• At least 2 years of recent outpatient hematology experience following fellowship.

• Strong clinical experience diagnosing and managing hematologic disorders, including treatment planning and longitudinal patient care.

• Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.

• Solid understanding of hematologic treatments, transfusion practices, anticoagulation management, and laboratory interpretation.

• Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.

• Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience treating both malignant and non-malignant hematologic conditions, such as leukemia, lymphoma, anemia, sickle cell disease, and coagulation disorders.

• Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Application process
Candidates will complete an AI interview to assess their relevant clinical expertise and experience.
About micro1

micro1 is a data lab that connects professionals with opportunities to apply their expertise to customer projects. We work with specialists across fields such as engineering, finance, healthcare, and law to support AI labs and enterprises. Through our extended network, contributors bring their knowledge and judgment to projects with their own scope, requirements, and engagement terms.

title: Engineering Manager - Pipelines
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Pipelines team at Supabase. Supabase Pipelines is a managed change data capture product. It copies the tables you select from Supabase Postgres to other systems, then streams later changes. The product is in public alpha, with BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckLake and Snowflake destinations.

Pipelines uses Postgres logical replication and Supabase ETL, our open source replication engine written in Rust. The team works close to the database. That means replication slots, WAL retention, initial table syncs, and the load they place on a customer's source database. The team also builds and runs the destination connectors. Correctness, ordering and recovery matter there as much as speed.

The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery and technical role. We don't expect you to write production code. We do expect you to join design discussions and help set the bar for engineering quality, testing and operations.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Team & People

- Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

- Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

- Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.

Hiring

- Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

- Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

Delivery & Roadmap

- Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones.

- Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on.

- Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

- Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

- Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

- Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

- Lead blameless post-incident reviews

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

- Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

- Have managed a team that built and ran data pipelines, change data capture, replication or streaming systems.

- Have strong technical credibility in data systems. We look for delivery guarantees, ordering, idempotency, schema changes and backfills.

- Know Postgres replication well, including logical replication, the WAL and replication slots, and how they affect a production database.

- Know analytical destinations such as BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse or lakehouse table formats like Iceberg.

- Have led a team through production incidents on a system that holds customer data. You ran the follow-up work and kept the review blameless.

- Have shipped a developer-facing data product to customers outside your company.

- Have experience with Rust (not required but a plus)

- Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

- Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

- Build psychological safety and a feedback culture. You give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do t

title: SMB Account Executive - Canada
description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions - to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality,  book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes - large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

 

The Role

At Square, we’re re-imagining how small and midsize businesses grow. As an SMB Account Executive , you’ll convert high-quality inbound leads into long-term customers - while also sourcing your own opportunities to keep your pipeline full. You’ll be at the heart of our growth engine: fast-paced, metrics-obsessed, and built for people who hold themselves to a higher bar than anyone else will. This is a role for people who don’t wait for direction, don’t make excuses, and don’t settle for “good enough”. 

If you’re a closer who thrives on momentum, loves solving problems for real businesses, and wants to work hard in a high-energy environment where effort translates directly into success - this is your role.

Square offers the opportunity to operate in a fast-paced outbound environment where your outreach brings Square’s tools to more sellers - and your success becomes part of our mission to level the playing field for entrepreneurs. We move fast, learn continuously, and reward grit and results by offering uncapped earning potential.

You Will

• Own the full sales cycle - from first conversation to close - with SMB merchants across a variety of industries.

• Engage and convert a steady flow of warm inbound leads from marketing, partnerships, and product interest.

• Generate a meaningful portion of your pipeline through outbound. You relentlessly build your pipeline through outbound prospecting - you don’t rely on inbound, you outwork it. You know how to identify new opportunities, craft personalized outreach, and create demand where none existed.

• Operate with urgency across every stage - - you manage time and priorities effectively in a high-volume environment. You move fast, and don’t let deals stall.

• Understand customer pain points and deliver value-based, consultative solutions that drive measurable impact. You diagnose real business problems and take ownership of solving them.

• Collaborate across teams (Onboarding, Product, Marketing, and Support) to ensure a seamless customer experience and continuous feedback loop.

• Track and forecast your pipeline accurately in Salesforce - you’re data-driven and use metrics to improve performance.

• Consistently hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue goals.

 

• Raise your own bar every quarter - improving conversion rates, deal size, and activity without being asked.

title: Junior RF Test Engineer
description:
About Us: At Quartermaster, we believe the ocean should be a safe and sustainably managed resource for all. By leveraging cutting-edge AI and robotics, we unlock capabilities that were only recently impossible. Our distributed open-ocean systems enable every vessel to sense, compute, and communicate, enhancing maritime domain awareness for those who need it most.

Job Description: Quartermaster is hiring a hands-on, versatile, and curious Junior Test Engineer for our new RF Test Lab in Columbia, Maryland. If you love working with Raspberry Pis, various sensors, microcontrollers, and software-defined radios, we want to hear from you. No two days will look the same: one day you might be building a test rig, the next you’ll be in the lab debugging hardware or analyzing RF data. Your work will feed directly into high-profile projects that help our customers succeed. We’re looking for someone who wants to build and test the next generation of maritime sensing systems.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Run RF tests on Quartermaster-designed systems, then analyze and document the results.

- Write and carry out test plans and procedures.

- Troubleshoot, rework, and repair electronics at the board and system level.

- Support our developers with system-level testing as designs move toward production.

- Help build out a brand-new lab, from setting up equipment to developing new test capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

- A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

- Experience with lab equipment such as spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, and vector network analyzers.

- Soldering and hands-on assembly skills, including circuit-board-level work.

- Some programming experience, ideally in Python.

- Basic networking and computer configuration skills.

- Clear, organized documentation habits.

- Ideally, familiarity with schematic entry, PCB layout, and PCB fabrication and assembly.

- Experience coordinating work across teams.

- Mechanical skills are a plus.

Work Environment:

- This is an onsite position in Columbia MD.

- Flexible working hours with occasional deadlines requiring high availability.

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

- Occasional day trips to HQ in Arlington (~ 3 days a month).

Benefits:

- Competitive salary

- Flexible work hours

- Opportunities for professional development and continued education.
